nodes.description: Variants reduce HDAC3 interaction with the CoREST and NCoR corepressor complexes - universally with KDM1A (CoREST) and, for most variants, with NCoR1/2 - compromising the corepressor machinery independently of catalytic activity. HDAC3 acts through the NCoR/SMRT corepressors that drive transcriptional repression during brain development.

evidence.snippet: our experiments demonstrate that HDAC3 variants perturb interactions with the CoREST and NCoR complexes, particularly involving KDM1A and NCoR1/2, which we posit as a central pathogenic mechanism underlying the clinical findings observed in the affected individuals

evidence.reference_title: De novo missense variants in HDAC3 leading to epigenetic machinery dysfunction are associated with a variable neurodevelopmental disorder.

nodes.description: Heterozygous de novo missense variants in HDAC3. Variant position determines which downstream functions are affected: residues near the catalytic pocket (Asp93, Pro201, Leu266, Gly267) impair deacetylase activity, whereas distal residues (Ala110, Arg359) chiefly disrupt corepressor-complex assembly and nuclear localisation.
